name: Balatonföldvár (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Balatonföldvár: a crowned blue and yellow shield with a sailing boat, a sun, a tree and a castle, with a helm, a crest and blue, yellow and green mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Balatonföldvár arms with crown, helm, crest and mantling
